subject: general
question: LCM of 5/33, 25/11, 20/55 and 15/77 is:
solution:
**Given:**

The fraction = {5over33},{25over11},{20over55}, and {15over77}

**Formula used:**

L.C.M. of {xover y}, {pover q} =(L.C.M. of Numerator)over(H.C.F. of Denominator) = {L.C.M. of {(x,p)}over H.C.F. of {}(y,q)}

**Calculation:**

Let the L.C.M. of given fractions.

According to the question

L.C.M. of the (5, 25, 20, and 15) = (5), (5 × 5), (2² × 5), (3 × 5)

L.C.M. of the (5, 25,20, and 15) = 2² × 3 × 5² = 300

The H.C.F. of (33, 11, 55, and 77) = (3 × 11), (11), (5 × 11), (7 × 11) = 11

The L.C.M. of the {5over33},{25over11},{20over55}, and {15over77} = {300over11}

**∴ The required result will be 300over11.**
